lines.t: (Verse 1)
You keep talking ‘bout the fire, but my hands are cold
Preaching ‘bout the branches while the roots take hold
I’ve been dressing up my coping like it’s self‑control
All this smoke in my lungs from a starving soul(Pre‑Chorus)
You don’t stare at the bottle, you’re staring at the well
You don’t blame all the symptoms, you’re reading what they tell
Every habit just a language that my wounds can spell
You’re not here to drag me, You’re here to break the spell(Chorus)
You go for the heart, not the high
Cut off the cords I’ve been calling my life
Tear down the idols I keep inside
Till the lust and the craving run dry
You go for the heart, not the high
Love is the blade and the healer this time
I’m walking out of the dark I hide
‘Cause You go for the heart, not the high(Verse 2)
I’ve been sleeping in a temple that I built of lies
All the neon on my skin, but I’m dead inside
All these pretty little poisons that I romanticize
But You read between the lines in my bloodshot eyes(Pre‑Chorus)
You don’t fix up the branches on a dying tree
You put Your hands in the dirt where the roots can’t breathe
Pull the thorns and the doctrine out of my beliefs
Turn my coping into crying, crying into peace(Chorus)
You go for the heart, not the high
Cut off the cords I’ve been calling my life
Tear down the idols I keep inside
Till the lust and the craving run dry
You go for the heart, not the high
Love is the blade and the healer this time
I’m walking out of the dark I hide
‘Cause You go for the heart, not the high(Bridge)
Strip my pride, burn my disguise
Let every hidden motive come to light
If I lose my world to be made alive
Then let it die, let it die, let it die(Outro)
You go for the heart, not the high…
You go for the heart, not the high…
